stemMd: A box contains 5 white and 7 black balls. One is selected uniformly at random. What is the probability it is not white?
explanationMd: Not white means black in this box. There are 7 favourable balls among 12 total, so the probability is 7/12.

distractorRationale.e: This compares colour counts rather than favourable to total.
distractorRationale.b: This is the probability of white.
distractorRationale.a: This counts one black ball only.
distractorRationale.c: The colour counts are not equal.
